description_en: Calls the StopMPUTask operation to stop a stream relay task
description_zh: 调用StopMPUTask停止旁路转推任务
kebab_example: aliyun rtc stop-mpu-task --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopMPUTask

parameters.description_en:
The application ID. Only a single ID can be passed.

> You can create and query the application ID in the [console](https://rtc.console.aliyun.com/manage/list#/manage/list).
parameters.description_zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。

> 您可以在[控制台](https://rtc.console.aliyun.com/manage/list#/manage/list)创建和查询。
